entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I... I think I need to return something? I bought these cycling shoes and I'm just... I'm so lost with your website. It's all a bit overwhelming.
I can certainly help you with a return. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

I'm not sure what you mean. They just don't feel right. I tried to get the cleats attached, which was a nightmare, and when I finally went for a ride they gave me terrible blisters on my heels. I just don't think they're for me. Can't you just help me? I'd really just like a refund.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes were uncomfortable and caused blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. It sounds like a sizing or fit preference. Let me see what I can do. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so... It's VF8675309. I hope it's not too late. I think I got them about a month ago.
Thank you for that. Let me pull it up... Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Lace cycling shoes, delivered 32 days ago. I just need to check our return policy for you. One moment.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've reviewed the policy, and you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this for a full refund for you.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. So I can send them back?

Yes, of course. And I see here that you're a VIP member with us, so as a courtesy, I'm waiving the return shipping fee. I have just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on your account. Just pack the shoes and cleats in the original box, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Wow, thank you so much, Diana! You've made this so simple. I was really stressed about this. That's a huge help.

It's my pleasure. We appreciate your business and want to make things right. Once we receive the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's everything! Thank you again for all your help.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
